doc.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Meeting Bud Powell through his brother Richard
summary: Richard Powell visits the record shop and brings McLean to meet Bud, home on furlough from a mental institution.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Is that how you came to be introduced to Bud as well?

I met Bud because his brother wandered into the record shop. I was playing Bud’s with Bird on a recording. He piped up, after the guy bought the record and went out. I said, “Can I help you?” He said, “That was my brother on that record.” I said, “Who?” He said, “Bud Powell.” I said, “What’s your name?” He said, “Richard Powell.” I said, “You play music?” He said, “No.” I said, “Aw man, you ain’t Bud Powell’s brother. Get out of here.” So he – he was all dressed up in a painter’s uniform, with paint all over his face and his clothes. He said, “Oh yeah. I’ll come back and prove it to you, man.” He said, “My brother’s coming home Sunday. I’ll come by here. I’ll prove it to you.” So I said, “Sure. I’ll be here Sunday. I’ll see you later.” So he split, and I forgot about it. That Sunday, I was in the back of the store practicing, and he came in there and took me around the corner. That was the first time I met Bud.

It just – I was frightened to death. I’d never seen Bud Powell. So I didn’t know what he looked like anyway. And Bud was coming home from a mental institution on a weekend furlough. So Bud was out to lunch anyway.
